Northern Rehab Physical Therapy Specialists is a privately-owned outpatient physical therapy clinic. Established over 45 years ago in 1978, Northern Rehab has earned its reputation as a provider of both primary and specialty orthopedic and sports physical therapy offering cost-effective, hands on care in a fun, friendly clinical atmosphere. With our diverse staff of specialists, Northern Rehab provides a wide range of physical therapy treatment for our clients, and additional programs and educational services for the communities we serve. Voted Best Physical Therapists in DeKalb County annually since 2012.
